title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2611.25905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprises are moving agentic workloads from closed APIs to their own open-weight model deployments. For this reason, lifecycle-wide validation, from small-scale testing through sizing and pre-production to production, becomes all the more important. Typically, rollouts are evaluated with ad hoc tools whose accuracy is rarely checked. We present an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving and empirically ground the design choices that connect its stages. Our experiments show that replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of the original agent sessions: at the 95th percentile replay stays within 1.18x of the recorded input tokens while live re-runs reach 4.98x, so a small set of recorded sessions yields a repeatable per-session token load. translated_title: 面向智能体工作负载的大语言模型推理平台的验证驱动部署
translated_abstract: 企业正在将智能体工作负载从封闭的API迁移到自身的开放权重模型部署上。因此，从小规模测试、容量规划与预生产到生产的全生命周期验证变得愈发重要。通常情况下，系统上线部署是使用临时性工具来评估的，而这些工具的准确性很少得到检验。我们提出了一个面向智能体大语言模型服务的端到端评估流水线，并通过实验为连接其各阶段的设计选择提供实证依据。我们的实验表明，重放捕获的追踪记录能够重现原始智能体会话的单会话负载：在第95百分位上，重放的输入令牌数保持在记录值的1.18倍以内，而实时重跑则达到4.98倍，因此少量记录的会话即可产生可重复的单会话令牌负载。对vLLM的代码覆盖率分析进一步表明，在该配置下所评估的实时、重放和合成工作负载是互补的：每种负载都执行不同的Python代码段。
tldr: 本文提出了一个面向智能体LLM服务的端到端评估流水线，证明重放捕获的追踪记录能以高保真度（95分位下1.18倍，而实时重跑达4.98倍）重现原始智能体会话负载，且实时、重放和合成工作负载在代码覆盖上相互补充。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an end-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving, showing that trace replay reproduces original agent session loads with high fidelity (within 1.18x at the 95th percentile vs. 4.98x for live re-runs), while live, replayed, and synthetic workloads provide complementary code coverage.
